 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Prabhat Kumar Singh
6 08-01-2025 Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2. The petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 498A/504/506/35 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that both parties have resolved and settled their dispute in terms of settlement mutually agreed upon by them.
A copy of the settlement is annexed with the mediator's report dated 20.12.2024.
4. Learned counsel for opposite party no.2 does not controvert the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner.
5. Considering the mediator's report, prayer for bail of Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.32789 of 2024(6) dt.08-01-2025 the petitioner is allowed.

In the event of arrest/surrender within six weeks from today, let the petitioner, mentioned above, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Patna Sadar, Patna in Mahila Police Station Case No. 32/2021, subject to the conditions laid down under section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure as well as in terms of Akash Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 8 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/104641082/
1 settlement.
